In this podcast, we reveal exactly how to make viral content 100% using AI — and how this impacts everything from app development to launching your own app. We explore how mobile app development is changing in 2025, how to plan your app development roadmap, and why mastering coding and app development for beginners is easier than ever with AI tools.

We discuss the role of programming in content creation, how a modern software developer can leverage AI to stand out, and step-by-step guidance on how to develop an app and how to create an app that actually gains traction. I break down how AI is transforming software development and even streamlining full stack development for content-focused creators.

If you're trying to figure out the right business model or start a business around your ideas, this episode also covers how to make an app that supports your brand, and how to make an app that ties into viral content strategies.

AI is also unlocking powerful business ideas, including new business ideas, best business ideas, and scalable app ideas that can go viral with the right execution.

This isn’t just about AI — it’s about how to combine AI, content, and app development to dominate in 2025.
